connections.title: Connections

descriptions.microsoft_365: Connect SharePoint to your knowledge bases.

connections.loadError: The connections could not be loaded.

microsoft365.loadError: The Microsoft 365 connection could not be loaded.

setup.title: Entra app
setup.clientSecretKept: Leave empty to keep the stored secret.
setup.clientSecretLooksLikeId: This looks like the secret's ID. Enter the secret's value instead: it's only shown once, when the secret is created; if it's lost, create a new secret.

save.error: The Microsoft 365 connection could not be saved.

remove.title: Remove Microsoft 365 connection?
remove.description: The tenant ID, client ID and client secret are deleted. You can set up the connection again at any time.
remove.error: The Microsoft 365 connection could not be removed.

test.title: Connection test
test.description: Requests a token for the app from Microsoft Entra and shows the permissions granted to it.
test.error: The connection could not be tested.
test.notSetUp: The Microsoft 365 connection is no longer set up.
test.otherGranted: Also granted, not used by Ayunis: {{permissions}}

connected.title: Connected
connected.hint: Ayunis can sign in with this app.

tenant_not_found.title: Tenant not found
tenant_not_found.hint: Microsoft Entra doesn't know this directory (tenant) ID. Copy it from the app's overview page in the Entra admin center.

client_not_found.title: App not found in this tenant
client_not_found.hint: Use the Application (client) ID from the app's overview page, not the Object ID or the secret's ID. Check that the tenant ID is the one the app is registered in.

client_secret_invalid.title: Client secret invalid
client_secret_invalid.hint: Enter the secret's value, not its secret ID. The value is only shown once, when the secret is created; if it's lost, create a new secret.

client_secret_expired.title: Client secret expired
client_secret_expired.hint: Create a new client secret under Certificates & secrets and enter its value.

consent_missing.title: No permissions granted
consent_missing.hint: Add Sites.Selected under Microsoft Graph (not SharePoint) as an application permission, then grant admin consent.

consent_on_wrong_api.title: Permissions added under SharePoint
consent_on_wrong_api.hint: The permissions must be added under Microsoft Graph, not SharePoint, as application permissions, followed by admin consent.

required_permission_missing.title: Sites.Selected missing
required_permission_missing.hint: Add Sites.Selected under Microsoft Graph as an application permission, then grant admin consent.

rejected.title: Microsoft Entra refused the sign-in
rejected.hint: Entra issued no token for the app, e.g. because of a Conditional Access policy or a disabled app. IT can look up the error code.

microsoft_unavailable.title: Microsoft not reachable
microsoft_unavailable.hint: Microsoft Entra didn't answer. Try again in a few minutes.

unexpected_error.title: Connection not tested
unexpected_error.hint: The connection was saved, but the test failed because of an unexpected error. Test the connection again.

tenantId.matches: Enter the directory (tenant) ID as a GUID, e.g. 6f1c2c4e-3c1a-4f4e-9a59-2f1f0b8a7d11.

clientId.matches: Enter the application (client) ID as a GUID, e.g. 0b8a7d11-2f1f-4f4e-9a59-6f1c2c4e3c1a.

clientSecret.maxLength: The client secret value must be 1024 characters or fewer.
